review: Dental topical anesthesia and Parkinson odor training do not measure voice loudness. Continue voice and dysphonia sources.

Concentrated-oil poisoning gives acute drowsiness. The older-adult inhalation registration measures insomnia and sleep quality rather than daytime sleepiness. Continue spice and daytime somnolence results.
Depression, anxiety and fatigue scales do not yield a separate apathy estimate. Trace individual motivation and Parkinson nonmotor item tables.
Injected clove oil motor proxies and eugenol catalepsy differ in route and preparation. Eugenol pretreatment and post-treatment gave different results.
Postviral multi-odor training included thyme and showed a favorable total score. Follow primary comparator, olfactory item reports and fresh oral exposure.
Two thyme lozenge reports give subjective comfort or hoarseness, with inconclusive objective voice results in the smaller trial. Continue listener-rated intelligibility sources.
Dried thyme reduced HADS anxiety in students. The paraquat study lists maze behavior. Continue Parkinson anxiety measures, protocol history and mouse full text.
Separate eugenol spray and inhaler reports found no clear salivary-flow change in healthy people. Drooling severity and sample overlap remain open.
The whole-species extract abstract and separate thymol and carvacrol experiments report different motor outcomes. Obtain the thyme mouse task tables and search for clinical postural measurements.
Thyme essential oil changed guinea pig bladder strip behavior in both directions depending on the endpoint and concentration. Clinical urgency and fresh thyme intake are unresolved.
Oral eugenol and levodopa were tested in a lesion model. The retrieved study did not report human OFF time. Continue meal and medication diaries.
Clove topical anesthesia and smell testing do not provide a speech intelligibility measure. Continue oral motor adverse-event and clinical speech searches.
Isolated carvacrol prevented vacuous chewing in a reserpine model. The fresh thyme, Parkinson and clinical dyskinesia comparison remains open.
Parkinson multi-odor training reported composite cognition. Continue executive subscales and distinguish isolated clove from the odor bundle.
Eugenol inhibited evoked contraction in rat bladder strips. Continue the Indonesian clove oil strip thesis and urgency results in humans.
Dental studies and Parkinson motor model assays do not score facial expressiveness. Continue masked-facies and MDS-UPDRS item sources.
Eugenol timing changed beam crossing in opposite directions in a toxin model. Continue oral ground-clove evidence with a prospective falls count.
Injected clove oil movement proxies and oral eugenol locomotion gave timing- and model-dependent signals. Continue clinical bradykinesia item searches.
Parkinson multi-odor training gives anxiety context. Continue isolated clove human trial and regional thesis verification.
Thyme anxiety and post-COVID fatigue studies do not score apathy. Continue Parkinson motivation-item searches.
Motor coordination and voice tasks give no handwriting-size outcome. Continue micrographia and fine-motor item searches.
Dried thyme trial measured self-rated memory. Attention was not separately tested. Continue attention tasks and fresh leaf exposure.
The reviewed thyme studies do not give a visual hallucination measure. Continue Parkinson psychosis adverse-event and individual symptom searches.

Topical ground-clove gel reduced dental challenge pain. The pediatric studies gave both an unfavorable active-comparator result and inconclusive contrasts. Continue the Parkinson pain and culinary exposure trails.
A diagnostic clove odor item had an inconclusive association with the freezing phenotype. This does not estimate the effect of ingestion on freezing episodes.
The reported thyme motor tasks give no facial expression score. Continue motor item tables and culinary exposure.
